summary: Wave 1 cleanup verification — backend pytest (7/7 hard delete + nifty health PASS in 2.94s) + Playwright sweep across /admin/companies, /admin/dashboard, /admin/invoices, /admin/onboarding, /admin/revenue (404 confirmed), /portal milestones, and CompanyDetailDrawer contacts tab. Support email routing confirmed at code level (SUPPORT_EMAIL=support@bybloomlabs.com, FOUNDER cc'd, X-Bloom-Ticket/Support-UID/Company headers wired in contact_routes.py:493-504). /api/clients/me/contact smoke test returned ticket_ref=BL-2026-0057 (matches BL-YYYY-#### format). All 12 review items verified PASS — zero functional regressions found. Only nit: TipTap duplicate 'link' extension warning persists (already documented in iteration_25, non-blocking) and a benign 'DialogContent requires DialogTitle' a11y warning on the company drawer.

issues: Radix a11y console warning: '`DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' Wrap the drawer's visible company name in a <DialogTitle> (or VisuallyHidden DialogTitle) to silence. Non-blocking.
Pre-existing iteration_25 nit still present: duplicate 'link' extension warning at TipTap init. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional/nit) Wrap company drawer title in <DialogTitle> (or VisuallyHidden) to clear the Radix a11y console warning.
(Optional/nit) Disable StarterKit's built-in link extension in RichTextEditor.jsx to clear the TipTap duplicate-extension warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend DELETE /api/admin/companies/{id}/hard cascades correctly: returns {ok:true, deleted:{company:1, contacts>=2, activity>=1}}. Subsequent GET on company returns 404 and contact-hard-delete on a cascaded contact also returns 404. Verified end-to-end.
Backend DELETE /api/admin/contacts/{id}/hard correctly refuses primary contact with HTTP 400 (detail contains 'primary'), and deletes non-primary with 200. Both paths covered by tests.
GET /api/admin/integrations/health no longer returns a 'nifty' provider entry — confirmed via curl and pytest. Now returns exactly: openrouter, emailit, paypal, slack, google_calendar, breezedocs.

/admin/companies renders clean (no 'Trash2 is not defined' crash). 92 company rows render with hover-revealed delete buttons exposing data-testid=admin-company-delete-{id}. Trash2 lucide import is in place.

CompanyDetailDrawer → Contacts tab: primary contact shows star/promote button only (testid drawer-contact-{id}), non-primary contact shows BOTH star AND drawer-contact-delete-{id} trash button. Verified by seeding a 2-contact company and listing drawer testids: ['drawer-contact-{primary_id}', 'drawer-contact-{secondary_id}', 'drawer-contact-delete-{secondary_id}'] — exactly 1 delete button as expected. Hard-delete cleanup of the seed company succeeded.
Dashboard integrations health strip: no 'nifty' anywhere in the rendered DOM. All 5 expected provider pills (openrouter/emailit/paypal/slack/breezedocs) render.

Admin sidebar renders 6 groups in correct order: DAILY → PIPELINE → DELIVERY → MONEY → AUTHORITY → SYSTEM. Project Mode + Project Files live under DELIVERY. NO Revenue link, NO Nifty link. /admin/revenue navigation returns blank body + react-router 'No routes matched location' warning — route fully removed.

/admin/invoices View action: clicking the ExternalLink icon issues GET /api/admin/invoices/{id}/pdf with `Authorization: Bearer <bloom_admin_token>` header → 200 OK. localStorage.bloom_admin_token confirmed populated post-login.

/admin/onboarding ProjectBriefDialog WYSIWYG markdown paste: pasted '## Heading 2 **bold text** and *italic* - bullet one - bullet two' into the TipTap editor. Resulting innerHTML: `

Heading 2

bold text and italic

  • bullet one

  • bullet two

`. Raw `##`/`**` characters NOT present anywhere — tiptap-markdown transformPastedText is wired up correctly.

/portal Milestones tab: 5 placeholder nodes render with data-placeholder='true', computed opacity=0.5, classes include 'opacity-50', 'UP NEXT' pill text present (uppercase), and all 5 standard phases (Discovery & Brief Sign-off, Design Language, Build — Core flows, QA & Polish, Launch) visible in greyed-out style.

Backend POST /api/clients/me/contact (multipart) returns ticket_ref matching BL-YYYY-#### format (BL-2026-0057 observed). Code path in contact_routes.py:493-504 verified: primary_to=SUPPORT_EMAIL ('support@bybloomlabs.com'), cc_list includes FOUNDER_EMAIL, headers X-Bloom-Ticket/X-Bloom-Support-UID/X-Bloom-Company set on email payload. Endpoint healthy and produces ticket+notification.

Per-phase AI Project Brief regression: dialog still opens with all 3 phase tabs, prompt copy, summary editor, save/send buttons present (covered in iteration_25; no regression observed while accessing the same dialog for the markdown paste test).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 8 frontend flows verified, only 2 non-blocking console a11y warnings)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Wave 1 cleanup features (delete companies/contacts, sidebar reorg, /admin/revenue removal, Nifty UI removal from health endpoint+dashboard+sidebar, milestone placeholders, WYSIWYG markdown paste, invoice PDF auth header, support email routing) are production-ready. Re-run hard-delete suite with: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://seo-dashboard-test.preview.emergentagent.com && pytest /app/backend/tests/test_hard_delete.py -v` (2.94s, 7/7 PASS). For sidebar/companies/invoices/onboarding/portal/drawer Playwright sweep, see iteration_26 transcript.
